title: On the Rokhlin lemma for infinite measure-preserving bijections
summary: We study the Rokhlin lemma in the context of infinite measure-preserving bijections, and completely classify such bijections up to $λ$-approximate conjugacy, where $λ$ is the infinite measure which is preserved. This sharpens the classical version of the Rokhlin lemma, which only provides such a classification up to $μ$-approximate conjugacy where $μ$ is a probability measure equivalent to $λ$.
